answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 5697 Country: India Title: I am 32 year old and facing problem of baldness, Pls advice regarding hair weaving or hair transplant or wig to cover my baldness. Is it permissible in Islam? Question: Brother, I am 32 year old and facing problem of baldness, Pls advice regarding hair weaving or hair transplant or wig to cover my baldness. Is it permissible in Islam? Regards, Answer ID: 5697 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 851/734=B) If it is of artificial hair then it is allowable, but avoiding it is better. However, using human hair is not allowed. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
